reach_geometry.frame: position_m: report frame, Z up, metres; the body faces -Y and its right side is -X at frame 0 (utils/motiogen/task_geometry.py); origin: the method's initial pelvis joint projected on the floor. target_body_m: [forward, right, up] in the same frame. The nominal Rajagopal body stands for the pelvis joint with its hip-centre midpoint (convention, not derived; its pelvis origin is 5.6 cm ahead of that midpoint); in HumanML3D standing frames the pelvis joint is 1.2 cm ahead of the hip midpoint, so a method receives each target 1.2 cm further forward relative to its hips than the nominal check assumed (sensitivity: reachability_origin_shift_+0.012.json)
reach_geometry.horizontal_reach: 0.8 x arm length from the shoulder (约定), nominal Rajagopal body; front = straight ahead at the shoulder, side90 = lateral

overhead.definition: the overhead zone is defined by world height (the height below) and by upper-arm elevation against the vertical (>= 91.2 deg in front, >= 105.3 deg at the side, elevation_check); in front it does not guarantee an elevation above 90 deg relative to the thorax: with the largest backward trunk lean it can be as low as 67.8 deg (user 2026-11-09, answer received between 03:17 and 03:21); the strategy actually used is reported in the analysis plan (Q3_ergonomics.overhead_strategy)

elevation_check.reading: minimum over all reaching poses found (multi-start SLSQP, local): upper arm against the vertical >= 91.2 deg in front and 105.3 deg at the side, i.e. above 90; relative to the thorax (the RULA reading) the side stays above 90 (102.7) but in front a backward trunk lean reaches the target with 67.8 (right) / 76.1 (left) deg; the left-right asymmetry of a symmetric model shows the minimum is local, so the true thoracic minimum in front is at most 67.8 deg

scale_rule.rule: one N for every method and every switch group of a method: the largest N with sum over groups g of t_g x min(A_m, N) <= B, where t_g is the measured GPU seconds per window of group g (batch sampling as the official script does it), A_m the number of official test windows available to method m and B the budget; lower bound 512: if N < 512, OmniControl is reduced to 2 groups (realism 1, spatial 0 / 1: the primary contrast) and N recomputed; if still N < 512, N = 512 and the excess over B is reported to the user before generation. A method with A_m < N uses all its windows and says so; the other methods are not reduced
scale_rule.budget: B = 75 GPU h (约定; the user may change it before the separate registration)
scale_rule.windows: every group of a method uses the same windows and the same number; when A_m > N they are drawn without replacement from the official test-set list in its fixed order with seed 20261109 (约定); otherwise all
scale_rule.reason: the registered contrasts are within a method, so the groups of a method need the same windows and the same N; one N for all methods so that a later comparison with the user's method uses the same N, and the rule stays simple (user 2026-11-09)
scale_rule.known_now: OMOMO has 480 test windows (evalkit self-check ground truth) < 512, so CHOIS uses all 480; its embeddings are 512-dimensional and the official FID is undefined (singular covariance) on subsets of 256 or fewer

reference_counts_from_self_checks.note: ground-truth embeddings of the evalkit self-checks; A_m is read from each official test loader in the separate registration

fid_interval.effect: per method and registered contrast: FID(arm 1) - FID(arm 0), each against the ground truth of the same windows
fid_interval.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261108 (as the analysis plan; 约定): each resample draws window indices with replacement once and applies them to both arms and to the ground-truth reference (windows are paired with their ground truth in every protocol here)
fid_interval.evidence: develop_logs/test_runs/20261109_inference_premises/fid_bootstrap_check.json (python/scripts/fid_bootstrap_check.py; self-check embeddings, 2 cm noise standing in for a generated set, 200 resamples): no resample failed; on OMOMO (N 480 < 512 dimensions) the paired resample keeps the median at 0.483 (0.473 without resampling, 95% 0.41-0.56) while a fixed reference gives 0.689 (0.37-1.26) and an independently resampled one 0.858 (0.38-1.70); on T2M (N 2324) the variants agree (30.08 vs 30.05)
